description: Synthetic SYMBIONT architecture reference: sMMO, ATPM 8.39, CH4/O2/NH4 uptake caps 16/28/2.3.

provenance.notes: Reference numerical check is approximately 0.2255827703 h^-1. These are capacity assumptions, not calibrated process settings.

assumptions: sMMO is enabled and both particulate methane monooxygenase routes are disabled.
ATPM is fixed at 8.39 mmol/(g modeled biomass h).
Methane, oxygen and ammonium caps are 16, 28 and 2.3 mmol/(g modeled biomass h).
Ammonium is the nitrogen input: nitrate and nitrite uptake are closed.
The cyanide source through SK_cyan_c is closed to prevent untracked nitrogen input to the ammonium inventory.
Mineral and phosphate bounds remain inherited and nonlimiting.
VS1/Bath equivalence, when used in a replay, is an experiment-specific user assumption.
